title: 7-in-1 Jump Starter 5000A with Air Compressor – 12V Battery Booster
descriptionHtml:
Stranded with a dead battery or a flat tire?

A drained car battery on a cold morning or a flat tire in the middle of the road – and suddenly you're stuck waiting for a tow. Depending on others when things go wrong is both stressful and expensive.

The whole roadside kit in pocket size

This 7-in-1 booster starts your car in seconds (up to 7.0 L gasoline / 6.0 L diesel), inflates the tire with a 150 psi air compressor, lights up with an LED emergency light and charges your devices via QC3.0. All in one unit you keep in the glove compartment.

Features

  • 5000A starting power – starts most gasoline and diesel cars.
  • 150 psi air compressor – inflates tires, bikes and balls.
  • LCD display – full overview of charge and pressure.
  • LED emergency light – with SOS and flashing mode.
  • QC3.0 fast charging – charge your phone and devices.
  • Compact and portable – fits in the glove compartment.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
